description: CASE ... WHEN ... END CASE as a procedural STATEMENT (Snowflake Scripting), run in anonymous BEGIN...END blocks. Covers the SEARCHED form (CASE WHEN <cond> THEN ...) and the SIMPLE form (CASE <operand> WHEN <value> THEN ...), the ELSE fallback when nothing matches, FIRST-MATCH-WINS when two branches are both true, and the no-match-without-ELSE case, where the statement is a no-op and the variable keeps its initial value. This is distinct from CASE as an EXPRESSION, which the procedural-expression tests cover. Converted 1:1 from scripting/CaseStatementTest (now retired); the blocks are written on one line here, which the scripting parser reads identically.

steps.sql: BEGIN LET x INTEGER := 2; LET result INTEGER := 0; CASE WHEN x = 1 THEN result := 10; WHEN x = 2 THEN result := 20; ELSE result := 99; END CASE; RETURN result; END
BEGIN LET x INTEGER := 7; LET result INTEGER := 0; CASE WHEN x = 1 THEN result := 10; WHEN x = 2 THEN result := 20; ELSE result := 99; END CASE; RETURN result; END
BEGIN LET x INTEGER := 2; LET result INTEGER := 0; CASE x WHEN 1 THEN result := 10; WHEN 2 THEN result := 20; ELSE result := 99; END CASE; RETURN result; END
BEGIN LET x INTEGER := 7; LET result INTEGER := 0; CASE WHEN x = 1 THEN result := 10; WHEN x = 2 THEN result := 20; END CASE; RETURN result; END
BEGIN LET x INTEGER := 5; LET result INTEGER := 0; CASE WHEN x > 0 THEN result := 1; WHEN x > 1 THEN result := 2; END CASE; RETURN result; END
